title: Ancient Water Evidence Map (project-defined index)
not_a_probability: Scores rank where orbital data and geologic mapping point to rocks formed or altered by ANCIENT water. They are not probabilities of finding water, and say nothing about present-day water, ice or groundwater.

formula.expression: score = Σ wᵢ·sᵢ / Σ wᵢ over the components available in the cell; coverage = Σ wᵢ(available) / Σ wᵢ(all)

mineral.text: M = min(1, (indicator share + 0.4 × weak-signal share) / 0.25) of the cell's measured CRISM pixels, counting only signals that no other CRISM observation of the same spot contradicts (±2 px)

unit_reason.NHjf2: USGS: deltaic fan deposits; inlet and outlet channels 'suggest deposition into a lacustrine environment'.
unit_reason.NHjf1: USGS: older deltaic fan deposits of the same lake system.
unit_reason.Nle: USGS: 'either deposited into an existing lake within Jezero or subsequently altered by later lacustrine processes'.
unit_reason.Njf: USGS: volcanic ash or airfall deposit that 'may have been modified by subsequent lacustrine activity'.
unit_reason.Nue: USGS: volcanic ash or other clastic drape; no lake link stated, but it lies inside the former lake basin.
unit_reason.cr: USGS: impact target rock uplifted in the crater rim; not a water-lain deposit.
unit_reason.Aeb: USGS: young (Amazonian) wind-blown ripples that cover older rock, so they hide rather than show water evidence.

geology.text: G = area-weighted prior of the USGS SIM 3464 units in the cell

landform.text: L = min(1, local relief / 40 m), relief = p95 − p5 of CTX DTM elevation over a 3×3-cell (~270 m) window

formula.assumption: All weights, priors, thresholds and saturation values are PAWPRINT assumptions, not calibrated values.

rejected.name: MRO SHARAD orbital radar
rejected.why: Footprint is about 3-6 km across-track (Fresnel zone; focusing cannot sharpen it) and 0.3-1 km along-track, while this whole area is about 7 x 5 km. Vertical resolution is 15 m in free space. Surface clutter from the crater rim and delta scarps would dominate, and no validated subsurface water or ice detection exists for this area. Using it would imply detail the data cannot support.

rejected.name: SWIM (Subsurface Water Ice Mapping) ice-consistency maps
rejected.why: SWIM maps the likelihood of PRESENT-DAY buried water ice, using regional-scale (km to tens of km) inputs. It covers 60S-60N, with the strongest signals poleward of about 40 degrees; Jezero is at 18.4N. It answers a different question (modern ice for resources), not ancient lake evidence, and is far coarser than this map.

rejected.name: Mars 2020 RIMFAX ground-penetrating radar
rejected.why: Real, archived PDS data exist along Perseverance's traverse, so this area IS covered, but only as 1-D radargrams under the rover's wheels. Turning them into a 2-D area score would invent values between tracks, and interpreting layering needs radargram processing that PAWPRINT does not do. They were not downloaded (large archive; ask first). Candidate future add-on: show the traverse segments that have RIMFAX coverage, linking to the PDS browse radargrams.

rejected.name: HiRISE DTM (1 m) for the landform term
rejected.why: Used for routing, but it covers only the south-east window of this area. Mixing it into the score would create a resolution seam, so the landform term uses the CTX DTM (20 m), which covers everything.
